camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamSnapshotInfo --region cn-hangzhou --Order asc --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --Limit 10 --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Queries snapshot content within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询某一段时间内截图内容
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-stream-snapshot-info --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --limit 10 --order asc --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamSnapshotInfo

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain of the streamer.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user who calls this operation has the permissions to operate on the specified domain name
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the stream. Make sure that the specified stream name exists within the query time range
parameters.help_zh: 播流名称，请确保传入的流名在查询时间段内是存在的
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The end time. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed **1** day. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过**1**天。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return in a single call. Valid values: **1 to 100**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 一次调用获取的数量。取值范围：**1~100**， 默认值：**10**
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **asc** (default): ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序。取值：

- **asc**（默认值）：升序。
- **desc**：降序
parameters.name: order
